email_subject: Application - Social Media & Marketing Specialist (Maternity Cover)
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Social Media & Marketing Specialist position (12-month maternity cover) at Yusen Logistics. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your global social media and marketing activities.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I also run my own project, mirook.com, where I have implemented structured data and social media integration to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on experience has strengthened my skills in content planning, analytics, and project coordination.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it combines social media strategy, brand consistency, and cross-regional collaboration. My ability to translate brand guidelines into engaging content, coupled with my analytical mindset, makes me well-suited to support your global communications team.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and work in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level. I am eager to bring my creativity and structured approach to Yusen Logistics.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
